purpose: Historical candidate source preservation; not an adoption recommendation or a claim that all changes were merged.
source_license: MIT; original repositories' licenses and attribution remain applicable to the archived source patches.

replay.workspace: Clean checkout of each entry's repository at base_commit.
replay.scope: Source, tests, manifests and documentation only; generated distributions are excluded. Rebuild distributions separately if needed.

verification.source_identity: Each patch was applied to its exact base in an isolated Git index and compared with recorded_tip; all tracked paths outside excluded_paths matched.
verification.product_validation: No new product build, deployment or device validation was performed for this archival cleanup.

entries.historical_note: Official DPlayer provides film state display. This old option also displayed filmError degradation for the former dual autoFilm/film API; that unique behavior is preserved here, not claimed to be merged into the official implementation.
